name: Rajashree Mohapatra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Rajashree Mohapatra writes poetry in Odia and English and also pursues painting. Her contributor biographies describe a background in teaching, history, journalism and environmental education. Her English poetry appears in journals including Our Poetry Archive and Raven Cage Zine; the latter also published “The Frozen Rain”, included here.

Seasonal and celestial images carry both inward reflection and social unease through these poems. “AUTUMN’S RAIN” weighs memory against the passing of youth, while “The Frozen Rain” follows endangered hopes towards a possible renewal. “The Lost Princess” brings a more urgent register: a plea for help set against a city’s violence and indifference.
